label: Hammer
note: MH3U G-rank hammer meta is the Grongigas Hammer with the Helios/Selene X package: Sharpness +1 (blue to purple), Awaken (Slime 400), HG Earplugs, Bombardier, and Partbreaker. The standard full Helios/Selene X set does not stack Attack Up or Critical Eye; those slots go to Awaken and roar protection. A common table-10 mixed variant swaps Partbreaker/Bombardier for Challenger +2, Earplugs, and Speed Sharpening, but Challenger's +25 true raw/+20% affinity is conditional on rage. The model captures Sharpness +1 and Awaken (unlocking Grongigas's hidden Slime 400); Bombardier's slime boost, Partbreaker, HG Earplugs, and Challenger +2 are unmodeled, and Element Atk Up stays 1.0 because Slime is a status and is not boosted by it. Honed Blade (Sharpness +1 + Attack Up (L), +20 true raw) is an alternative raw-hammer package, but Grongigas builds usually spend the budget on Awaken instead. Focus is generally avoided on hammer because it speeds past the level 2 charge, and Critical Draw is not used. The shared sharpness table uses MHFU multipliers; MH3U uses 1.05 green / 1.20 blue / 1.32 white / 1.44 purple, so absolute scores are not directly comparable across games.
